metadata.title: Card Break Platform
metadata.description: Hong Kong card break platform — pick team/player slots, pay securely, choose shipping after the live reveal.

auth.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid international phone number starting with + (e.g. +85291234567)
auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to lock a slot and complete payment
auth.signupSubtitle: Email and international phone are required for SF Express shipping and FPS payouts
auth.confirmEmail: Check your inbox and click the confirmation link to finish signing up.
auth.callbackError: The sign-in link expired or failed. Please log in again.

account.title: My Account
account.subtitle: View your profile and wallet balance
account.walletNote: If a break is cancelled, 100% of what you paid is credited to your on-site wallet (no Stripe refund). You can spend wallet credit at checkout — full credit checkout has zero gateway fees.
account.phaseNote: Phase 6: on-site wallet and cancellation credits are live.

breaks.listSubtitle: Pick a team or player slot. Checkout holds the slot for 8 minutes.
breaks.featuredSubtitle: Active listings loaded from your database
breaks.slotsSubtitle: Available slots can be checked out. Sold or locked slots cannot be purchased.

checkout.title: Your slot is locked
checkout.subtitle: Complete payment before the timer expires. Use wallet credit, Stripe, or both.
checkout.noWalletCredit: You have no wallet credit yet. Payment will go through Stripe.
checkout.payError: Could not start payment. Make sure your lock is still active and try again.
checkout.payHint: Cards · Apple Pay · Google Pay supported via Stripe
checkout.creditOnlyHint: Paid fully with wallet credit — no Stripe gateway fees.

paymentErrors.CREDIT_EXCEEDS_PRICE: Credit cannot exceed the slot price.
paymentErrors.LOCK_EXPIRED: Your lock expired. Go back and pick a slot again.
paymentErrors.SLOT_UNAVAILABLE: This slot is not available for purchase.

checkout.lockActive: This slot is reserved for you for 8 minutes. It releases automatically when the timer ends.
checkout.lockExpired: The lock expired and the slot was released. Go back and pick a slot again.
checkout.phaseNote: Phase 6: wallet credit, mixed checkout, and cancellation refunds are live.

success.title: Payment successful!
success.subtitle: Your slot is confirmed. After the live break, choose shipping from your account.

errors.title: Could not lock this slot
errors.SLOT_LOCKED_BY_OTHER: Another customer is checking out this slot. Pick a different one or try again later.
errors.SLOT_ALREADY_SOLD: This slot is already sold. Please choose another one.
errors.BREAK_NOT_ACTIVE: This break is no longer active.
errors.SLOT_NOT_FOUND: This slot could not be found.
errors.SLOT_UNAVAILABLE: This slot is not available for purchase.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.

admin.dashboardSubtitle: Create and manage card break events
admin.newBreakSubtitle: Add an event and team/player slots
admin.descriptionPlaceholder: 30-team break · Live on Instagram · Shipping after break
admin.slotsHint: One slot per line: Name,Price (e.g. Lakers,300)
admin.cancelBreakConfirm: Cancel "{title}"? All paid orders will be refunded 100% to user wallets (no Stripe refund).
admin.cancelBreakSuccess: Break cancelled. Refunded {count} order(s) to user wallets.
admin.cancelBreakError: Could not cancel this break. Please try again.

home.headline: Clean, fast, secure breaks
home.subheadline: Browse active breaks and claim your favourite team or player slot. Pay securely, watch the live reveal, then choose SF Express collect-on-delivery, pickup, or international shipping from your account.
home.phaseNote: Phase 4 complete: 8-minute slot lock. Next: Phase 5 Stripe payments.

footer.tagline: Built for HK and international collectors
